identity.summary: Full RTT/0–RTT/3 triadic mapping of the Egyptian pantheon across eight operator fields: Clarity, Shadow, Dimensional, Liminal, Projection, Flow, Emergent, and Void.
identity.purpose: Define the structural supersphere of Egyptian mythology using operator grammar, field geometry, paradox forms, liminal corridors, cycle maps, and emergent bestiary for use within the TriadicFrameworks registry.

geometry.rtt1_result: Pass — high clarity-shadow contrast, strong dimensional spine
geometry.rtt2_structure: Clarity cone + Shadow cone + Dimensional spine + Liminal ring + Projection band + Flow band + Emergent ring + Void substrate
geometry.spine: Duat 12-gate underworld stack (Nut → Geb → Osiris → Ogdoad)

clarity.label: Clarity (C)
clarity.summary: Solar order, truth, cosmic balance, visible kingship.

dimensional.label: Dimensional (D)
dimensional.summary: Realms, underworld structure, sky/earth stack, gate architecture.
dimensional.spine: Duat (12 gates) · Nut · Geb · Osiris · Anubis

liminal.label: Liminal (L)
liminal.summary: Gates, crossings, knowledge thresholds, death-passage, resurrection corridors.

projection.label: Projection (P)
projection.summary: Cycles, avatars, royal and solar projection, divine lineage.
projection.ring: Solar barque · Pharaoh projection · Osiris → Horus projection cycle

flow.label: Flow (F)
flow.summary: River, air, moisture, solar, and underworld motion currents.
flow.band: Hapi · Shu · Tefnut · Sobek · Duat currents

emergent.label: Emergent (E)
emergent.summary: Hybrid guardians, paradox creatures, threshold hybrids, underworld forms.
emergent.ring: Sphinx · Serpopards · Ammut · Bennu · Wadjet · Uraeus

void.label: Void (V)
void.summary: Primordial waters, pre-form substrate, silence, the origin state.

clarity_apex.name: Ra
clarity_apex.role: Solar order apex; daily rebirth cycle; nightly Duat traversal

shadow_apex.name: Set
shadow_apex.role: Chaos-guardian; inversion apex; defends Ra from Apophis while destroying Osiris

dimensional_apex.name: Osiris
dimensional_apex.role: Underworld king; death → kingship paradox; dimensional order

void_apex.name: Ogdoad
void_apex.role: Primordial substrate octet; pre-form waters; void-silence origin

paradox_forms.name: Osiris Paradox
paradox_forms.summary: Death produces kingship; dismemberment produces cosmic order.

paradox_forms.name: Horus Paradox
paradox_forms.summary: Vulnerability produces sovereignty; childhood produces legitimate rulership.

paradox_forms.name: Ra Paradox
paradox_forms.summary: Decline produces rebirth; nightly death produces sunrise.

paradox_forms.name: Set Paradox
paradox_forms.summary: Chaos protects order; destruction preserves cosmic stability.

paradox_forms.name: Ammut Paradox
paradox_forms.summary: Justice requires destruction; purity requires annihilation of the unjust.

paradox_forms.name: Sphinx Paradox
paradox_forms.summary: Protection requires obstruction; clarity requires passing the riddle.

paradox_forms.name: Isis Paradox
paradox_forms.summary: Grief produces resurrection; loss produces creation and lineage.

paradox_forms.name: Uraeus Paradox
paradox_forms.summary: Clarity requires destruction; protection requires annihilation of threats.

paradox_forms.name: Bennu Paradox
paradox_forms.summary: Self-destruction produces self-creation; dissolution produces renewal.

liminal_corridors.summary: Knowledge corridor; bridges cognition to realm structure and Duat navigation.
Primary liminal operator; guides souls through Duat's 12 gates.
Opener-of-ways; breaks through blocked gates and unlocks corridors.
Resurrection corridor; reassembles Osiris, bridges death to life, projects lineage.

cycles.name: Solar Cycle
cycles.summary: Ra's nightly Duat traversal; dawn → dusk → underworld → sunrise rebirth.
cycles.rtt_arc: Drift → Split → Fracture → Scatter → Rebind → Silence → Rebind

cycles.name: Osiris Cycle
cycles.summary: Death → dismemberment → resurrection → underworld kingship → Horus succession.

cycles.name: Nile Cycle
cycles.summary: Inundation → fertile silt deposit → recession → desert; mirrors underworld cycle.

cycles.name: Pharaonic Cycle
cycles.summary: Mortal ruler → divine projection → death → succession; mirrors solar and Osiris cycles.

emergent_bestiary.summary: Hybrid-dense emergent arm. Threshold-linked, underworld-coupled, solar-projection-connected, and paradox-active.

ai.purpose: Provide a complete structural triadic mapping of the Egyptian pantheon for analysis, comparison, and integration within the TriadicFrameworks pantheon registry.
ai.audience: Framework architects, pantheon analysts, AI systems, and researchers
